**Chao · 2019 · 临床**

Effects of Home Photobiomodulation Treatments on Cognitive and Behavioral Function, Cerebral Perfusion, and Resting-State Functional Connectivity in Patients with Dementia: A Pilot Trial

*Photobiomodulation, Photomedicine, and Laser Surgery* · [DOI: 10.1089/photob.2018.4555](https://doi.org/10.1089/photob.2018.4555) · [阅读全文](https://www.vielight.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/01/Brain_Photobiomodulation_Alzheimers_Chao_2019.pdf)

阅读范围：期刊正式版 PDF 全文，方法、表 2–4 和图 3–5。

[加入研究对比](../../research/tpbm-compare.html?selected=chao-2019-dementia-dmn) · [按问题读](../../research/tpbm-questions.qmd)

## 怎么做

```{=html}
<dl class="tp-study-fields">
<div><dt>研究对象</dt><dd>8 名痴呆受试者，照光 4 人、常规照护 4 人<br><a href="https://www.vielight.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/01/Brain_Photobiomodulation_Alzheimers_Chao_2019.pdf#page=2" target="_blank" rel="noopener">方法与表 1｜样本、常规照护和居家疗程</a></dd></div>
<div><dt>研究设计</dt><dd>随机平行先导试验，居家照光与常规照护对照<br><a href="https://www.vielight.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/01/Brain_Photobiomodulation_Alzheimers_Chao_2019.pdf#page=2" target="_blank" rel="noopener">方法与表 1｜样本、常规照护和居家疗程</a></dd></div>
<div><dt>波长</dt><dd>810 nm，LED<br><a href="https://www.vielight.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/01/Brain_Photobiomodulation_Alzheimers_Chao_2019.pdf#page=3" target="_blank" rel="noopener">图 1、表 2｜装置与出光参数</a></dd></div>
<div><dt>连续光 / 脉冲</dt><dd>40 Hz，50% 占空比<br><a href="https://www.vielight.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/01/Brain_Photobiomodulation_Alzheimers_Chao_2019.pdf#page=3" target="_blank" rel="noopener">图 1、表 2｜装置与出光参数</a></dd></div>
<div><dt>照射位置</dt><dd>1 个前部和 3 个后部经颅 LED，联合 1 个鼻内 LED<br><a href="https://www.vielight.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/01/Brain_Photobiomodulation_Alzheimers_Chao_2019.pdf#page=3" target="_blank" rel="noopener">图 1、表 2｜装置与出光参数</a></dd></div>
<div><dt>辐照度 / 功率</dt><dd>表列每 LED：后部 100、前部 75、鼻内 25 mW/cm²<br><a href="https://www.vielight.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/01/Brain_Photobiomodulation_Alzheimers_Chao_2019.pdf#page=3" target="_blank" rel="noopener">图 1、表 2｜装置与出光参数</a></dd></div>
<div><dt>光斑</dt><dd>约 1 cm²（每束，表 2）<br><a href="https://www.vielight.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/01/Brain_Photobiomodulation_Alzheimers_Chao_2019.pdf#page=3" target="_blank" rel="noopener">图 1、表 2｜装置与出光参数</a></dd></div>
<div><dt>照射时间与疗程</dt><dd>20 分钟/次，每周 3 次，12 周<br><a href="https://www.vielight.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/01/Brain_Photobiomodulation_Alzheimers_Chao_2019.pdf#page=2" target="_blank" rel="noopener">方法与表 1｜样本、常规照护和居家疗程</a></dd></div>
<div><dt>剂量</dt><dd>表列每 LED：后部 60、前部 45、鼻内 15 J/cm²；整套 240 J/次<br><a href="https://www.vielight.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/01/Brain_Photobiomodulation_Alzheimers_Chao_2019.pdf#page=3" target="_blank" rel="noopener">图 1、表 2｜装置与出光参数</a></dd></div>
<div><dt>对照怎么做</dt><dd>常规照护，无假设备；研究期间要求保持用药<br><a href="https://www.vielight.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/01/Brain_Photobiomodulation_Alzheimers_Chao_2019.pdf#page=2" target="_blank" rel="noopener">方法与表 1｜样本、常规照护和居家疗程</a></dd></div>
<div><dt>观察指标</dt><dd>ADAS-Cog、NPI-FS；3T 静息态 fMRI，以后扣带为种子；ASL 灌注<br><a href="https://www.vielight.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/01/Brain_Photobiomodulation_Alzheimers_Chao_2019.pdf#page=2" target="_blank" rel="noopener">方法与表 1｜样本、常规照护和居家疗程</a></dd></div>
<div><dt>测量时间</dt><dd>认知和行为在基线、第 6 与第 12 周；MRI 在基线及第 12 周<br><a href="https://www.vielight.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/01/Brain_Photobiomodulation_Alzheimers_Chao_2019.pdf#page=2" target="_blank" rel="noopener">方法与表 1｜样本、常规照护和居家疗程</a></dd></div>
</dl>
```

## 结果怎么看

- ADAS-Cog 均分由 37.5 变为 32.3（照光），由 32.1 变为 39.2（常规照护）；组别与时间交互 p = 0.007。（[表 3｜认知均值](https://www.vielight.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/01/Brain_Photobiomodulation_Alzheimers_Chao_2019.pdf#page=4)）
- 后扣带—外侧顶叶的组内变化方向相反，基线及第 12 周的两组直接比较均未达显著。（[表 4、图 5｜后扣带与外侧顶叶的功能连接](https://www.vielight.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/01/Brain_Photobiomodulation_Alzheimers_Chao_2019.pdf#page=6)）

## 对实验设计有什么用

保留刺激前后影像和认知双测量，增加外观与操作一致的假刺激。预先定义连接的组间变化量，以及每个人连接变化与认知变化的关联。
